decisions.reason: CAD-file retention is an independent documentation decision already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; wiring-plan retention requires no additional candidate change.
Retaining the wiring layout does not change the BOM's contents, component selections, compatibility rules, or current artifact obligations.
Physical access for maintenance is unaffected by retention of wiring-layout documentation; the source message's separate service-access clause is already represented.
Wiring-layout retention does not alter the requirement to keep liquids separated from electrical components; the separate food-service context extension is already represented.
Retaining wiring documentation does not change dispensing-path cleaning, sanitation access, or liquid-trap prevention requirements.
The food-safe material standard is established by a separate clause in the source message and is not changed by wiring-plan retention.
Documentation retention does not change the milestone-local strategy of using off-the-shelf electrical components.
Wiring-plan retention does not alter whisk removability or tool-free cleaning behavior; the separate retail food-service context is already represented.
Wiring-plan retention does not alter bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior; the separate cleaning and retail context extension is already represented.
Retaining wiring-layout documentation does not change the prototype's approved 120V wall-power source.
The documentation-retention decision does not alter dispensing controls, valve behavior, flow, or operator interaction.
Retaining the wiring layout does not change electrical load capacity, controller configuration, power-supply capacity, or overload margin.
